name: Pens and Pencils
justification: Any valid (x, y) pair is accepted, so the token checker cannot judge it — disqualified as a special judge.
solution_sketch:
x = ceil(a/c), y = ceil(b/d); print -1 if x + y > k, else any pair with x pens, y pencils and x + y <= k.
Multiple correct outputs exist, so a special judge is required.
